summary: Iteration 84 - New Destinations Testing Complete. All 9 new destinations (Berlin, Madrid, Prague, Vienna, Budapest, Istanbul, Florence, Dubai, Bali) verified working with correct airports, 4 stay_zones each, and must_see arrays. Template type fallback (is_generic_template=true) works for unknown destinations like Cancun. Alias matching works (vienna→viena, florence→florenca, istanbul→istambul, prague→praga). must_see adapts to num_days (3-day=6 items, 7-day=8 items). Navigation bar highlights active page in peach color #FFBE98.
